rv.q: Many real-life stories of heroism and loss have been told since then, including in the life-affirming Canadian musical “Come From Away,” being presented in a warm and winning production at Bill Hanney’s North Shore Music Theatre through September 27.
This Tony® Award-winning musical celebrates the best of the human spirit and the extraordinary capacity for good in the face of crisis!
Amid tragedy, Come From Away reminds us that kindness can be its own form of courage.

Come from Away is not without moments of shock, distress and uncertainty, but holds many more moments of warmth, encouragement and humor delivered in rich harmony that could very well spark a renewed faith in humanity.
As timely as it is timeless, ‘Come from Away’ is based on true events in the Newfoundland town of Gander during the week following the September 11, 2001 attacks, almost exactly 25 years ago.

cn.t: Critics praise this warm, uplifting production for its life-affirming celebration of kindness and heroism amid tragedy, finding it a winning reminder of human goodness in the face of one of history's darkest days.
